BEFORE YOU HIT THE ROAD

A few things you might ask.

Plan your trip ↗
Can I book a one-way drop taxi?

Yes. Choose one-way / drop, then your pickup city, destination and travel date. You do not need to plan a return trip.

How is round trip priced?

Round trip is ₹1 per km less than the one-way rate for the same car. Confirm the total fare, driver allowance, tolls, parking and any other applicable charges before accepting a trip.

Which locations do you cover?

We cover journeys across Tamil Nadu and popular nearby hill destinations such as Ooty, Kodaikanal and Munnar. You can enter any town or city. Availability is confirmed for your specific route.

How accurate are the “from” fares?

They are rough one-way sedan bases using ₹15/km × a typical highway distance. Tolls, bata and parking can change the total. Always confirm with our team.

Is my trip confirmed when I fill in the form?

No. The form prepares your trip details. A booking is confirmed only after the team agrees on availability, pickup details and the final fare with you.
